general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) combined with solid tint, NEVER pure transparent.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Apply crisp edges via semi-transparent borders + shadows.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions). Exclude transforms from universal 'transition-all'.

theme_and_colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Performance Pro for checkout speed.
rules: Forbidden Colors: Teal Green, Teal Blue (#1B93A4).
Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Always tint neutral greys with a slight cool blue or warm orange.
High contrast is mandatory for the POS screen to ensure fast scanning by cashiers.

palette.destructive: Signal Red (#EF4444) for void/remove item actions.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl tracking-tight font-light or font-black

layouts.global: Mobile-first responsive grids. Ensure optical alignment.

pos_tablet_screen.left_panel: col-span-1 lg:col-span-8. Contains Category-first browsing pills, search bar, and high-density product grid.
pos_tablet_screen.right_panel: col-span-1 lg:col-span-4. Persistent cart/receipt, total calculation, and massive touch-target 'Pay' button.

admin_dashboard.widgets: Cardless or 1px border. No soft shadows on flat widgets. 100% pixel utilization with h-full.

shadcn_overrides: Do not overuse standard cards. Use flat, rectangular, dense styles.
Input/Buttons on POS screen MUST have larger touch targets (h-12 or h-14) for fast tablet usage.
Dropdowns and Overlays MUST NOT have transparent backgrounds. Use bg-popover or bg-white/90 with backdrop-blur-xl.
Override Shadcn default border radius to max 8px (rounded-md).
components.navigation: Dashboard: Left sidebar (collapsible). POS: Locked top bar or bottom tab bar.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' (border-collapse style) for the Admin data tables. Use 'Neumorphism' clay & crisp variants for dashboard widgets.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky headers or modal overlays: bg-white/80 (light) or bg-black/70 (dark) + backdrop-blur-xl + 1px delicate inner stroke + saturate-150.
visual_enhancers.motion: Use Framer Motion for micro-interactions (e.g., item added to cart pop). Hover states must lift (-translate-y-1) and darken border.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for text. Use APCA guidelines.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY. All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cart items, tabs) MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='checkout-pay-button').

image_urls.description: Person holding a credit card at a modern retail checkout. Use with a heavy overlay (bg-black/60) for contrast.
Abstract business statistics graphic. Use sparingly as a visual enhancer in empty states.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. ALL frontend files must be written in .js (React JSX), NOT .tsx.
2. The interface language MUST be Bahasa Indonesia (e.g., Keranjang, Diskon, Pajak, Bayar, Tunai).
3. Implement a Light/Dark mode toggle (standard Tailwind 'dark' class).
4. Start with the Layout shell (Sidebar + Header). Ensure Header is NEVER fully transparent.
5. MOCKED INTEGRATION: Data APIs for Master Data, Inventory, and Sales must be mocked locally using state or local mock files. (HIGHLIGHT: MOCKED)
6. Do not center-align the app container in CSS.
7. Ensure the POS Kasir route has a distinct layout optimized for tablets (hide admin sidebar, maximize workspace).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js
